description: Compare the monthly USD cost of a public IP (EIP/弹性公网IP) across clouds, per region. Default scope 'eip_bound' = the IP cost while ATTACHED to a running instance: AWS/GCP/Azure charge ~$3.65/mo ($0.005/h) for every public IPv4, and Volcengine/UCloud charge a smaller fee; clouds ABSENT from the result give a bound IP for FREE (AlibabaCloud, TencentCloud, BaiduCloud, Huawei standard EIP) — absent means free, not missing data. Scope 'eip_idle' instead returns the penalty rate for an unbound/reserved IP. Pair with compare_egress + compare_bandwidth for a server's full public-network cost.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

scope.description: 'eip_bound' (default, IP attached to a running instance) or 'eip_idle' (unbound/reserved penalty rate)

name: compare_eip
title: Compare public IP cost
